provenance.verdictRule: Pass: readable text, all 3 core sections (Experience, Education, Skills) and name, email and phone all found. Partial: readable text and at least 2 core sections. Fail: no readable text, fewer than 2 core sections, or no name found.
provenance.scoredCondition: Headline verdicts use the shipped path: column-aware reading order, letter-spacing repair, and the layout evidence the site passes to the analyzer (PDF column pages; DOCX tables, text boxes, header/footer).

extractor: pdf.js 6.1.200 (the same library the ResumeAtlas parser ships in the browser); DOCX via the shipped extraction steps (mammoth 1.12.0 raw text + restoreDocxListMarkers) plus inspectDocxLayout; text-layer cross-check via Xpdf pdftotext 4.00
verdictRule: Pass: readable text, all 3 core sections (Experience, Education, Skills) and name, email and phone all found. Partial: readable text and at least 2 core sections. Fail: no readable text, fewer than 2 core sections, or no name found.
sampleRule: Canva groups: the first templates Canva's template gallery returned for the query, taken in order, exported with default settings (PDF Standard) and the template's own placeholder content. No template was added or removed by hand.

stressFlagged.label: Tables & columns
stressFlagged.failsWhen: Text merged across columns or cells, or entries separated from their dates

stressFlagged.label: Section detection
stressFlagged.failsWhen: Content left under no heading the parser recognizes

stressFlagged.label: Name
stressFlagged.failsWhen: Name inside a header band, logo, or image

stressFlagged.label: Skills
stressFlagged.failsWhen: A Skills heading whose items did not extract (grids, rating bars)

stressFlagged.label: Phone
stressFlagged.failsWhen: Number split across table cells or stylized

stressFlagged.label: Work experience
stressFlagged.failsWhen: Roles merged or missing title/date pairing

stressFlagged.label: Headers & footers
stressFlagged.failsWhen: Name/email/phone, or a whole section, only in a header, footer or text box the extraction dropped

stressFlagged.label: Email
stressFlagged.failsWhen: Email shown only as an icon or in a graphic

stressFlagged.label: Dates
stressFlagged.failsWhen: Mixed styles, “’21-’23”, or dates in graphics

stressFlagged.label: Education
stressFlagged.failsWhen: An Education heading with nothing readable under it

stressFlagged.label: Icons & graphics
stressFlagged.failsWhen: Contact icons, emoji, decorative glyphs, or text broken into fragments

stressFlagged.label: Bullet structure
stressFlagged.failsWhen: Not scored: missing bullet symbols are not an extraction failure
